research.title: US midterms: Fiscal, market and geopolitical implications of the "blue wave"
research.summary: Democrats have won control of the U.S. Legislature, riding a historic wave of support to equally historic margins in both the House and Senate. In this episode of Making Sense, Kathleen Mellody, head of J.P. Morgan's Federal Government Relations team, sits down with Bruce Kasman, chief global economist, and Derek Chollet, head of the JPMorganChase Center for Geopolitics, to unpack what this outcome could mean in the U.S. and abroad. Will it reshape fiscal policy, the outlook for growth and the AI buildout? Could it affect U.S.-China relations, as well ongoing conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine? And how does it align with electoral results in Brazil and Israel? Tune in for a fascinating look at what's ahead.
